rule: A source may enter an approved training/evaluation manifest only if its licence-register status is 'usable' (tier 1), or 'usable_with_restrictions' AND the restriction is documented and compatible with internal, non-commercial development (tier 2). Sources with status conflict / unverified / blocked / not_acquired are excluded until a human clears them and this file is revised.

tier2_restricted_known_terms.manual_in: project-owner collected; redistribution rights unverified - internal development only
tier2_restricted_known_terms.receiptbench: MIT repo licence but consent for personal receipts undocumented - internal development only

excluded_until_cleared.sroie: licence conflict (HF card CC-BY-4.0 vs ICDAR RRC terms)
excluded_until_cleared.funsd: licence not stated on card; project record says non-commercial research
excluded_until_cleared.in_financial: provenance conflict: DbCL database over web-scraped images, academic use only
